b.x: 01 Stop. One torch — not several candles. Gas smell? Light nothing; open and leave.
02 Shut the fridge. Food stays safe in the first hours if the door stays shut.
03 One phone on saver. The others can wait. The network will clog.
04 Check children, elders, the neighbor who depends on a lift or electrical kit.
05 Water: fill if pressure remains. Do not waste the tank.
06 A bulletin by radio or someone on the street — not from a dozen chats.
